## Analysis overview

Every figure and processed data file in this repository is produced by the
notebooks under `scripts/`. Each notebook reads from `data/raw/`, writes
analysis-ready tables to `data/processed/`, caches expensive model fits in
`data/interim/`, and saves publication figures to `output/figures/`. Raw
instrument output in `data/raw/` is never modified. Shared helper functions
live in `R/`.

The notebooks are grouped into four tracks, run in order within each track:

| Track | What it covers |
|---|---|
| `scripts/01_bioscreen_strains` | Monoculture growth across a streptomycin gradient (Bioscreen) |
| `scripts/02_biolog_ecoplates` | Carbon substrate use in monoculture (Biolog Ecoplates, Synergy H1) |
| `scripts/03_coculture_plates` | Competition in membrane-separated co-culture plates (Logphase 600) |
| `scripts/04_serial_transfer_coculture` | Serial transfer co-culture over five 48 hour cycles |
